faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp is the fastest way — message 07464 053505 and we reply during opening hours. You can also call the same number or email cedarevent@yahoo.com. Walk-ins are welcome subject to availability, but booking ahead means we can set aside the right amount of time.

faqs.question: Is a deposit required?
faqs.answer: Yes. A 20% deposit secures your booking. The balance is settled at the salon on the day.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: Please book at least 24 hours in advance so we can plan the day around your service.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.answer: Cancellation is free within 24 hours of paying your deposit, and you can reschedule at any time — just let us know.

faqs.question: How long will my appointment take?
faqs.answer: Between 20 minutes and 4 hours, depending on the service. Longer braiding, knotless and loc work sits at the top of that range, so allow plenty of time.

faqs.question: Do you have prices for nails, makeup, gele, facials, lashes and threading?
faqs.answer: These are quoted on enquiry rather than listed, because the work is tailored to you. Message us with what you have in mind and we will confirm the price before you book. The full hair price list is published on this page.

faqs.question: Do you style children’s and teenagers’ hair?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cornrows, single plaits and box braids for children and teenagers are all in the price list, under Kids & Teens.

faqs.question: Where are you and when are you open?
faqs.answer: We are at 40/42 Powis Street, Woolwich, London SE18 6QS, and we are open Monday – Sunday, 9am – 9pm.

sectionLedes: Hair, beauty and personal style in one place, in the heart of Woolwich. Open seven days a week, and late enough in the evening to fit around work.
Hair, nails, spa, makeup, gele, facials, lashes and the boutique, all under one roof on Powis Street. Choose where to start.
From braids and extensions to silk presses, cuts and wig styling, discover a look that complements you and your routine.
Beautifully finished manicures, pedicures, gel colour and nail art, tailored to your personal style.
Massage and body treatments to unwind and reset — a short session between appointments, or a longer one at the end of a long week.
Discover clothing, fabrics and accessories to complement your style, from everyday favourites to special-occasion pieces.
A soft daytime finish, or full glamour for an occasion. Bring a picture of the look you have in mind and we will match it to your skin tone.
The headwrap that finishes a wedding, a naming ceremony or a birthday. Bring your fabric and your outfit, and we will tie a shape that sits with both.
Cleansing, exfoliation and massage, chosen around your skin rather than picked off a fixed menu. Tell us how it behaves and we will build the treatment around it.
Lashes to frame the eye, and threading for brows and face. Slow, exact work — the whole difference is in a millimetre either way.
Discover beauty essentials for your everyday routine. Message us on WhatsApp to check availability and arrange collection from the salon.
Explore our latest style videos on TikTok, then share your favourite with us when you book.
Explore our hair services below. For nails, makeup, gele, facials, lashes and threading, contact us for a personalised quote before booking.
The questions we answer most often. If yours is not here, message us and we will tell you straight away.
Passionate about hair, beauty and making people feel welcome? We would love to hear from you.
We welcome walk-ins subject to availability. Book ahead so we can set aside the time and care your chosen service deserves.
